notes.title: 2024/3/9 Text remastered and added
notes.content:
German language added
Text translation with AI translator.

English text
The full English text was re-translated with the AI translator, proofread with the conventional translator and finally adjusted manually.
Compared to the original translation results, the new text has more precise semantic, contextual and grammatical expressions.
It is more colloquial and contains fewer redundant words.

Fix problems
Fixed some language problems.
Remove some code statements.

notes.content:
Do you like playing the viola as the main melody? Do you like piano, music box, finger organ, woodwind, and even string arrangement? If I let them play together! Would you like it?
There are no restless modern elements, but more direct communication of musical spirit that strikes deep into the soul.
Built in music for free download!!!

30 songs are included 
All included songs are in FLAC format, 96kHz, 24bit
The built-in songs in the game are all in wave format, 48kHz, 24bit
In terms of listening experience, the sound quality of this music pack will be more vibrant in low frequencies and atmosphere.
